Review Text: This product is extremely effective and I have actually noticed a significant difference with fine lines and hyperpigmentation.  I only wish it was 1/3rd of the price.

I used a whole bottle of this because I was looking for an eye treatment. I don’t know if it really does anything for dark circle, but it plumps the skin. I don’t recommend wearing this under makeup because it sometimes pills and just looks weird under concealer. I use this mostly when I go make-up free and at night
Literally the only tanner that doesn’t turn me orange or streaky. I will die if they ever stop making it.
No notíciame difference after three months of use.

Love the ingredients, packaging, and scent! I haven’t been able to use it long enough to notice a long term effect, but it definitely does feel like it calms my face down. Great for after a peel or just in winter when things are dryer.
Feels nice but did not remove blackheads. Not going to repurchase

I received this product complimentary of Influenster. I have used it for about 3 days. I like how thick and smooth the cream is. A little goes a long way. I don’t notice a difference as of yet in my eyes. However, I’m in my 30s so I tried it as a preventive method. I also just purchased the 3 step clinique facial care system to use with this to see the best results.

I had high hopes for this product to lighten my uneven skin tone around my mouth and chin area. I apply it twice daily and after using it for 2 months, have not noticed any changes in my skin tone. It probably works for people with acne scars or blemishes.

I love this product. It’s gentle on my rashy skin, and when I have the energy to keep up my skincare routine, this pared with other products seem to help with the rashiness. My issue is with the container it comes in. I love the style of the container, but when the container and contents are in a warm environment (like a hot steamy shower or an non-airconditioned bathroom) the pump acts as a siphon and large amounts of the product are lost overnight. This cleanser is not cheap, and it sucks to lose a third of the product to the shelves in my shower rather than my face.
Makes skin very dewy, fresh looking. Wear in over makeup and alone. Seems got few small acnes after using it. Or maybe just a coincidence. Will buy again

I got the deluxe sample of this cleanser. Used about 2 weeks & overall I love how this doesn’t feel dry after washing my face. It feels clean without feeling it stripped me of any moisture. I would recommend to anyone that’s interested!

I’ve been using this for a few months now and the most immediate/short term result was hydration. I have very dry skin and this did wonders. However, the hydration wasn’t lasting if I skipped a day of using this. As far as anti-aging, no overnight miracles but I think it did help maintain my skin through plenty of sun exposure. It’s not perfumed - doesn’t smell like anything really. I’ve used the overnight restorative cream as well and that smelled nice but was less hydrating. This cream also feels a little more greasy. A little goes along way so it has lasted me awhile and is worth the price for that reason. I like to try different products but I would purchase this again.
Wish they would bring these back permanently again !!

The sunscreen itself is pretty great. Goes on smooth, feels great, light tint that works well for my skin tone. It is rather runny and can come out of the bottle a little too fast. I do think the price is a bit high, but my main frustration is the bottle! The finish flakes off terribly, getting everywhere, including in your hands when you’re trying to apply the sunscreen. I end up with little purple flakes on my face, which is pretty annoying unless you have plans for a day rave.
I used this product for approximately 6 months after suffering from acne scars; it works VERY WELL. Ladies just be PATIENT. It’s worth the money! Blessing

I have oily but dry skin = cystic acne. I’ve tried it all. Cool thing about oily skin is that most of my friends have fine lines and I don’t, however, cystic acne has scarred.I use this in combo with other face washes. I wouldn’t use this everyday, it reminds me of the salicylic acne washes from middle school/high school days.Stripping all oil from your skin is not the answer. I repeat, stripping all oil from your skin is not the answer and will cause more blemishes. Find a wash that washes dirt and oil without your face feeling like a dry chalk board. PCA oily wash - use this daily and mix checks and balances in once or twice a week. PS- Get retinol from a doctor. Stop wasting money on weak retinol online tisk tiskThank me later :*

So first off, it does what it says it’ll do. It removes makeup well. Everything melted right off, granted I don’t wear a ton of makeup. I was worried it wouldn’t wash off well but it did. This basically does what a makeup wipe does but it’s way less abrasive. I thought the smell was pleasant. I followed up with a face wash!

I have very high hope for this product since a lot of youtubers rave about this, and I love the beautiful design of the bottle. However, It was underwhelmed in my opinion. It just does nothing special. It does leave your skin feel soft and clean, and the smell of it is nice too. But in terms of removing makeup, I found it hard to spread on my face (I prefer a more running consistency), and I feel like I have to use a lot of products to remove all my makeup. Among all the cleansing oil I have tried, this one is definitely below average, and I can’t see how will this become anyone’s must have.

I got this as a sample first from BoxyCharm and thought it was kind of overpriced, but it ended up working really well after going through a few days of exfoliating products in my skin care routine. You might have to do a couple washes with it, but it does a good job of getting rid of everything so you don’t peel throughout the day. Did such a good job actually that I bought the full size once I saw what it could do!!I also tried using an exfoliating sponge before this, but since this is chemical, it did a better job of sloughing off everything so I didn’t peel later in the day.

i can’t give a full review on effectiveness as i haven’t been using it long enough i can say it hasn’t had any negative effects on my skin! the reason for my review is i saw many mentions of the smell and thought i could add some helpful commentary. the smell is not pleasant the way their other products are but is not extremely offensive either. the closest comparison i can make is it smells like a lot of fake slime/gak childrens toys. the smell on the face doesn’t last very long after application but does really stick around on your hands if you don’t wash them afterwards.

It was meh for the cost. I ended up breaking out from it even though I normally do not break out. as for hydration it was less performance than the serums that costed 10s. But maybe my skin is just that hella dry. HOWEVER, the smell BUSSIN! still recommend it for the rich normal skinned homies out there who just want good time.
I’ll admit that my skin looked great and moisturized when I used this however, this gave me really bad breakouts which went away/stopped after discontinuing. Beware if you’re acne prone.

i like the texture of this moisturizer however it stings my skin when I apply it (and I do not have overly sensitive skin) and causes lasting redness.  my skin does feel smooth and well hydrated though.
I have bad roscea, so tried this.  It’s adds an extra layer of coverage.  But I could have accomplished the same thing w/extra concealer.

At first I really loved this cleanser, I felt like it was working and left my face feeling clean. However, after about a week, my skin turned incredibly scaly/flaky and I was breaking out like crazy. I have relatively acne prone skin and am oily in some places, dry in others. This product was supposed to work well for acne and anti aging but I did not care for it. Having pimples and wrinkles at the same time should not be an option!
Thhydrating but a little greasy feeling even a while after application.

I’m halfway thru this and just not sure it’s doing anything. I don’t have too many eye wrinkles but some very fine lines and I can still see them unfortunately. I was hoping this would take them away based on the high reviews but no such luck as of yet. It is light and moisturizing and absorbs nicely but I just don’t see that it truly helps with diminishing fine lines and wrinkles which is the main reason I bought it. I will not be purchasing again but instead next will be purchasing Shiseido Future Solution LX Eye and Lip Contour Regenerating Cream and see if that does the trick.

Honestly I’m using it as a makeup remover rather than cleanser. I felt my skin needed double cleansing when I use it! It’s good for anyone who use light makeup but for me I needed something more to melt my makeup

There are many things I like about this product, the texture is almost whipped and smooth to apply, the smell is lovely, and you can feel it working. My skin does feel smoother and look awake after I apply this! However, I find it a little bit strong- so even for my oily skin I’ll only leave this for 2-3 min to avoid irritation. Also it’s difficult to remove- if I use a cloth or just my hands, there’s still a sandy-feeling residue that lingers. I prefer to put this on right before I jump in the shower to thoroughly rinse it off.

I got this for Christmas and i’ve used it maybe a month and my skin has already cleared up so much! it leaves a odd tight feeling on your face and it will burn if you have really had active acne but i say it’s worth it!

I love essence.  I’ve been using them since I went to Japan last year.  I’ve tried several brands from both Japan and Korea and while this one is fine, and does hydrate, it’s no better than the one I picked up in the drugstore in Japan for a fraction of the price.  On the plus side, it doesn’t have a strong fragrance like some of the others I have tried (fragrance can be damaging to skin).   It just seems a bit pricey for what you get, though with essence, a little goes a long way.

I almost never write reviews, and there are tons of products that I love… but rarely do I buy a product for a specific issue and see immediate results the way I did with this face lotion. I have been struggling with extremely dry skin on my forehead for almost two months…so much so that even when I used Summer Fridays mask under my tinted Tula primer my forehead still looked uneven/flakey. I tried every face lotion and oil I had in my arsenal and nothing helped. This Skinfix cream resolved the issue within a couple of days. Completely! A godsend.

Hum Nutrition - Flatter Me Digestive Enzymes Supplements. I have been taking it for more than a few days now and haven’t really notice any differences yet, only time will tell. I also didn’t notice any side effects.
Very luxurious and does the job.

I have dry skin most of the time and this honestly makes my skin feel really soft and prepped for foundation. it is nice and smooth and the fragrance is not strong and smells good. I would reccomend this product for sure!
this is not my favorite cleanser. it’s ok but it doesn’t seem like anything special. for this price I much rather purchase something Iove more!

I liked this moisturizer but didnt love it. It smells wonderful and applies easily. My skin did not feel as moisturizered as normal with this, still felt a little dry for me.  With that being said. i have hard to manage skin and have to be careful with what I use. I didnt hate this moisturizer and would definitely recommend it to people to give it a try and see if it works for them.

It smells like ginger which I love, and I like how it has niacinamide and spf, but I feel like it left a white cast on my face and didn’t do much for my redness. I was hoping it would help cover some red acne spots but that wasn’t the case

my honest opinion. This lotion is very hydrating and smells really nice. I haven’t noticed any firming or change of color as yet. But is definitely hydrating and only a little amount is needed to cover a large area.

I have sensitive, acne-prone, dehydrated skin. This eye cream does help with dark circles and hydrates. However, it’s way too rich, it caused mila around my eyes. It also made the skin around my eyes more sensitive.
Non offensive smell and does the trick.

This is an okay retinol but & prob good for sensitive skin. But I noticed no changes in my skin. TBCH my skin looked better when I was using honeymoon glow from the farmacy. I was hoping this would help with acne scars and texture and just give me that kind of clean glossier skin but I sort of think my skin looks worse now after a month of using this about every other day. Pretty disappointed because I read a million articles hearing this is what celebs use, but to be honest maybe they just had good skin to begin with

I bought these but didn’t have incredibly high hopes. i have stubborn hormonal acne. but! they actually do a pretty good job of calming spots down. of course, they don’t completely diminish the pimple, but i don’t wake up to a volcano on my face when i use these. the pimple in question ends up being flat in the morning which leaves me with little to worry about besides it healing on its own from there. would recommend!
I keep using the product for about 2 weeks so far..and my rosacea has decreased a lot!! plus..it’s not oily at all.

I have really bad cystic acne I get horrible break outs in my cheek area after I started using this product I do feel I big improve the it is really Cooling and it does not burn on my problem areas like other products with salyzcidic acid ibe seen improvement in my skin i can’t say it did a 360 on my skin cuz i haven’t being using it enough but so far I do enjoy it I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I first got this in the trial size and then bought the full bottle. As someone with acne prone skin this product doesn’t do it for me even though it may nourish my skin. Basically a normal cleanser for double the price. I only recommend this if you just want a very basic cleanser.

I have used this twice in the past week. The first time I was really impressed and immediately saw far fewer blackheads on my nose. Did not minimize pores so much but cleaned out the grozz stuff. The second time I used it, I wasn’t as impressed and as another reviewer noted, within a day it seemed my blackheads were back and same as ever. Also, the second time I used it, the product either irritated my skin and caused it to peel or it left some kind of residue that I had to exfoliate off. Perhaps i just need to use it more sparingly (I have sensitive skin).Last thing I’d mention is it does smell a bit funny, at least to me, but I mean you are rubbing charcoal goo on your face so no surprise.

I used this product combined with the other 3 Sk-II products I received as a 4-step skincare routine. I was very hopeful for this brand after looking at the prices, reviews, and website claims. I noticed no positive differences in my skin after a few weeks of use and was disappointed in the ingredients. It contains multiple Parabens. I would not recommend and won’t be purchasing.
This moisturizer goes on so smoothly! I’ve seen improvements in firmness and hydration. It truly feels like second skin. Defiantly worth the money.
This product is so amazing!  I thought it was going to be gimmicky but i really wanted to try it.  I wasn’t a fan of summer fridays because the Jet Lag Mask didn’t work for me and I didn’t like the R

At this price, I didn’t need a miracle to prefer this is product over any other moisturizers, really. The “no marketing“ isn’t a problem for me because I’m a skincare geek and I look for ingredients rather than promises. Indeed, the ingredients are what appealed me first. I have dehydrated combo skin so I can get really oily during the day in response to too greasy moisturizers and/or not enough moister so my skin produces sebum to combat blabalbla. So I have to put on some kind of moisterizer. I look for ingredients that target that kind of need and this one has exactly that and it’s working really well for me. The price is a bonus honestly because I would be looking for that exact formula anyway. With this one in the morning, my skin does not get oily or dry during the day. Which is like a f miracle.

I got a sample of this scrub in my latest order. First, the positives: It smells really nice, like strawberries and honey, very natural. The texture is also really nice, you only need a tiny bit because it is pretty concentrated so it should last longer than most scrubs. However, if you have sensitive skin like me, I think this is way too harsh. While i did get a nice glow immediately after rinsing, later on my skin broke out in irritation bumps. If you have sensitive skin that breaks out from too harsh of scrubs or products, you know what I’m talking about. Though I don’t recommend it for the face if you have sensitive skin, it works great on the hands and as a body scrub!

Initially this worked well and felt hydrating but after 2-3 weeks I developed a rash around my mouth and chin area. I switched back to Skinfix and Cerave, the rash is now healing. It has been one week so the rash is not completely gone but definitely improving. This product has a distinct fragrance so that is my best guess as to what caused the irritation.

I had been looking for a new cleanser that was “clean” and cruelty-free and came across Youth to the People’s skincare range. While I like some of their other products this cleanser really just didn’t do it for me. I have very oily skin and found this to be way too drying. I suspect it’s a bit more on the alkaline side, and my acne-probe skin did not react well. Packaging it nice. Smells fresh. But I will not be purchasing the full size.

My very first Sephora review, bc this mask is AMAZING! It’s so glossy and buttery, without being sticky. I was struggling with dry, patchy lips that looked awful and scaly if I tried to apply lip color. After only 4 nights use, my lips have never been softer! Will be repurchasing for years to come

I tried a delux sample and used only on my neck and décolletag. I was afraid to use this on my face as I break out easily. After trying Josie Maran Argan oil on my neck and décolletag, I returned to this product by tarte because it is supposed to brighten in addition to nourishing properties and the cost is comparable. This time I bought the 1.7 oz dropper bottle. What a waste of materials for packaging! Cute, but a waste. The wood on the dropper lid was cracked, but that is cosmetic. The dropper works horrendously. I have to hold it above my hand and tap/shake out the drops. Depressing the button at the top causes the dropper to dispense ALL the oil it is holding. I wish I had kept the sample dropper bottle and just continually refilled it as needed. I worry about this large bottle becoming contaminated as well. I started using on my cheeks, where I have the most sun damage and am least likely to break out, in addition to using on my neck and décolletag. I itch on my neck area occasionally after applying and I am wondering if it is this product. It has not made my cheeks break out after a few weeks of use, though I have had one or two small breakouts on my chest. My skin does feel nice and soft after application. It absorbs quickly and does not make me feel greasy. Not sure this will be the same in the summer. I am going to give it some more time and see if I see any brightening.
I just picked this up a week or so ago, and the pump is already not working. I’m super bummed because I liked it. It’s just not working anymore.

I truly don’t understand what the hype for this product is. At $40 for such a small sunscreen I would’ve expected much more. This product doesn’t go on fully clear and I notice a white tint on my face after applying. Also I’ve  sunscreen, so I’m not sure if it even truly protects that much. I feel like I’ve had much more success from using sunscreens that are a fraction of the price. The only upside was that it wasn’t greasy and didn’t cause breakouts.
I like this product for what it was. I’m not generally into facial peels, but this one was not abrasive at all and I didn’t mind it.
it’s hydrating for sure bit doesn’t really brighten dark circles as it should. tried for few months before giving up.

i have bipolar skin type, very dry on winter and tends to get oily in summer. This moisturizer is very creamy, it feels heavy on touch but once on your face it melts away and feels very light. Didn’t clog my pores and I don’t get breakouts. I have been using it for almost a year and I don’t see any problem so far. I think it is superior to clinique.
I wasn’t sure about these @ 1st but they have made a total difference for me, less break outs!
I received this from Influenster and personally I am not a fan of physical exfoliants so I was scared to used the product because they make me break out.

I received this product complimentary to review. This eye cream feels very luxurious and does moisturize. I did not notice any real drastic improvement on my under eyes though. I probably would not purchase this for $70.

Pretty good product! I got this to review from Influenster. The 5 pack is not enough to see a difference in my skin but I did feel more energize  and that’s most likely due to the vitamins included (vitamin c, e, and coq10). It tastes pretty good. I think the trial packs should be two weeks worth instead of 5 powders. Pro-tip: if you add the powder to cold water, it will clump up but shaking it will break up the clumps. It’s much better to add to room temp but I prefer colder water.
I am a huge fan of all the Rosebud products. The strawberry scent is so fun and I love how it feels on my lips! I still think the original Rosebud salve is better though :)
This doesn’t do much for me, in fact I find my skin gets a bit irritated by it. It’s also quite heavy.

I liked this product when I was using it. It didn’t help or hurt my acne, but I have chronically red skin, especially on my cheeks and T zone, and after only a few uses it started helping diminish that. I can’t use it since I added AHA and BHA products in my skincare  (the warnings say not to use with any retinols which this is) and I figured I’d play it safe and just stick to one and switch up routines every once in a while. It has a distinct herbal/mintish smell which I started liking after a couple uses, but it is noticeable for a while after application. Overall, it’s pretty good.

I used this hoping this would help prevent any dryness/sensitivity my skin experiences transitioning from summer to fall. After reading reviews, I thought this would be a great option. When applying, it feels so moisturizing, but after a couple of hours, my skin is left feeling tight and dry. So much that you could see cracking of my tinted moisturizer after a couple of hours. I really wanted to like this because of the packaging, but will be returning.
Not the best product I’ve tried but decent. I’m only 23 so I don’t really think this product was made for me to use at this point in my life honestly.

I have tried using different cleansers, and I would say this does the job okay-okay. It does not leave my skin dry but it does leave some of my eye liner and mascara. Though I have seen this issue with a lot of products that I have used in the past. Received this product complimentary from Dermalogica.

Pretty decent moisturizer. It does what it says in moisturizing your skin. I use it during the evening because it’s a little heavier than what I’d prefer for the day time. It has a slight medicinal smell, it’s not terrible, but if you’re sensitive to smells, you might notice it. It doesn’t bother me at all and the smell disappears really fast. It’s a lightweight cream, however it’s heavier than creams such as Tatcha’s water cream. This does claim to have Vitamin C in it, so be wary of that if you use retinol at night. Pricing wise, this is quite expensive for how much you actually get. The perks is that it is vegan and cruelty free, I haven’t tried other products like that so I can’t compare, but it is kind of expensive. The packaging honestly kind of sicks. The pump is so close to the base and the pump range is short and you have to pump all the way down to get product out. This makes you get product onto the pump and it’s annoying. Design wise, they could’ve done better.
Overall pretty good. I like the way it makes my skin look, and it provides some protection from the sun. It irritates my eyes tho, so if it’s bright out I’ll pile on the baby zinc sunscreen instead.

Perhaps I like this toner so much because the last one I tried (Lancome) was worthless, did nothing.  This has a nice scent (which some people may not like), and my skin feels wonderful after use!  I’m very happy with this toner.

I have to give presentations for my job but unfortunately, I have social anxiety and get beet red when I talk in front of crowds. I break out in what looks like hives on my face and neck. This is the ONLY product I’ve found that allows me to do my job without worry that my blushing will peek through! Life changing!

This SPF mist was gifted to me by Supergoop! for my honest review. I like this mist but I have some critiques as well. This mist is light and applies nicely. I like the mister-- nice and fine, although it does spray a little wide. I have to be sure to cover my hair and clothes when applying. It’s not overly heavy or greasy like some spray SPFs I’ve used in the past but it does leave a glow but it’s nothing a light dusting of powder wouldn’t remedy. The biggest criticism I have of the mist is the smell. It smells very strongly of chemicals, which I’m sure is unavoidable given that it’s an SPF, however, for me it kind of takes away from any “refreshing“ qualities it has.

I got this in a sample... the day after i used it, i noticed a little peeling around my chin, and it eventually worked its way all around my face and neck (wherever i had put the product). This is normal, I’ve heard, but unless you plan on not seeing anyone for a week or using moisturizer every 6hrs to mask the dry, dead, peeling skin all over your face and neck, I wouldn’t reccommend this. On the up side, after the peeling was done, my face looked bright and glowy. Even so, I wouldn’t spend my money on buying this.

J’ai littéralement tout essayé pour sauver ma peau sensible et réactive. Je n’ai pas aimé ce gel, aucun effet sur les rougeurs et la sensation de brûlure. Mesdames peau sensible : Laneige intensive crème hydratant a sauvé ma peau.

It breaks my heart to give this product 1 star, as DE is an amazing brand and I absolutely love everything they make. I received this product for free from Influenster to try and write an honest review. E-Rase irritates my eyes and did not remove my makeup effectively. I had to repeat the process several times and ultimately use a different product to finish it up. It’s a thicker formula, so it doesn’t work well with the cotton disc.
i have had tiny red bumps on my forehead FOREVER. wasnt even looking for this product to help, but it cleared them!!

I thought this would be a great product based on reviews and brand. I have dry skin and when I use this I don’t feel it really does anything to provide “instant hydration”. Just feels like I’m adding water to my face… I’ve been using for about a week and haven’t noticed any changes from that either. I will finish the bottle and hopefully I notice a better result but I find myself feeling like I have to use it because of the price instead of wanting to.

I did like this serum as a hyaluronic acid serum. I included it in my daily routine and thought it helped to hydrate my skin. I always make sure to apply to damp skin and it sinks in very quickly which I love. Makes it super easy to layer skincare. All in all, I like the serum but the price tag in my opinion makes it not worth it. There have been plenty of HA serums that I have tried, for much less and did a great job as well. It wasn’t luxurious enough to make me want to repurchase this specific product but happy I got to try it out.
Is this actually doing anything? I can’t tell. All I know is it leaves a sticky, tacky film.

I have never used chemical exfoliate so I can’t really compare this product to anything else, but it hasn’t given me any issues or irritations so far. It gently exfoliates and smoothens bumpy textures in 1 minute. It seemed like I had flaky skin on some part the next day and it looked pretty bad with makeup on. I’m not quite sure if it’s doing anything to my skin in a long run and I would honestly be able to live without it. I like it but I probably won’t purchase it if I have to pay for $60 for this tiny container. I don’t like the scrubs in this which are pretty hard and it feels like it’s scratching my face as massaging the product.
great product, but next time I’ll stick with the original Sugar-I like it better

I was using this product for a while it does a great job keeping my skin clear and seems to make my skin more even toned which is great so it does what it’s supposed to do. Was thinking there has to be a cheaper alternative cuz I don’t like the price tag. Saw couple of dupes and was sitting on it for a while and then decided to take the plunge and use Peace slices from Amazon. Does the same thing and is so much cheaper!!! Paulas choice will always be my fav and if I have money to spare I will buy this.
i dislike it so much. i brought it because the positive reviews.  the fragrance is so strong! the texture is okay but i can not get past the fragrance. it dries my lips. did not like this at all.

This product smells really bad.... I couldn’t even really try it out because of the smell. Every time I’d put it on my face the whole room would smell. Even the next morning the funky smell was still on my face. :(
I used this product to see if it would improve my pores and skin texture, no changes. I didn’t see any improvement as of yet. I was sent this product from Influenster

i received this as a sample using my points because i was so curious if this was worth the price tag. it is not. you can easily find amazing vitamin c serums for half the price. i can not believe she has the audacity to charge $150 for this subpar product.
nice thick creamy moisturizer that absorb into the skin quickly. It did not leave my face feeling greasy and it worked perfectly on my oily skin.
It was highly recommended by a Sephora employee. For me, it was only okay and I will not buy it again.

I was really excited about this product after reading so many great reviews, but I am quite disappointed with the results.  I love the Honey Potion mask by Farmacy and figured this would be a great addition to my skincare routine, however I was wrong.  This DOES NOT remove eye makeup (Bobbi Brown gel eyeliner and Benefit’s They’re Real non-waterproof mascara).  Even after using eye makeup remover before using this product I still get black smears under my eyes.  It also blurs your vision after using.  I do find that it removes my light foundation easily.  It smells really fresh and feels nice on the skin, but I would not recommend this for the price.
I was eager to get this in the mail but this mask made my skin peel & it started drying it out
I found this product just “sat“ on my lips instead of penetrating deep down.  Did not find it moisturizing or helpful at all.  Would not buy again.

This is quite small considering the price, but it is a very good sunscreen. It dries clear and does not feel greasy at all, making it the perfect sunscreen to wear on your face, and under foundation. I wore this to the river and usually burn pretty badly on my nose; however, I didn’t get a burn at all using this product. Would recommend. Only giving it 4 stars because of the price.
This made all my pores MASSIVE the next day. Dissapointed

Wouldn’t suggest this to younger girls and those that have sensitive skin. I’m 30 and my skin is farely healthy with no sensitivities. I love this product! Every time after spraying it on my face, my skin feels energized and refreshed! It does smell quite strong but I enjoy the smell. My friend that’s younger than my 9yrs complained that it stung her face, so please test it yourself!

Please get rid of the fragrance.  It’s preety common knowledge now that added parfum/frangrance irritates skin, especially those with sensative skin, which this is branded for.  Other than that, it’s lightweight for my skin in the hot, humid south Florida weather.

Pros: product is very moisturizing; comes in a nice bottle; good amount of product that will last for months Cons: I get the same moisturizing effect from my Vaseline lip balm for much cheaper price Conclusion: glad I tried it but probably won’t purchase again

Let me start off by saying: I have a wrecked digestive system. It has caused me problems for years to the point of debilitation. I’ve tried everything from “eating clean and healthy” for 6 years to colon cleanse pills, to elimination diets, other probiotics, supplements, etc.What I first noticed is: I didn’t hate swallowing these pills. I appreciate that there’s no taste and they’re really small. Secondly: I liked that it’s recommended to refrigerate because that means the probiotic cultures are alive.If you can tell from my before and after photos, everything else speaks for itself. I don’t have as much discoloration nor blotchiness on my face and I just look healthier. Maybe even glowy. But it’s only been 17 days so let’s wait and see if it’s from this product or not.
This product felt very good on my skin, not to drying but not the best for moisterzing

I’ve been using this after my toner and I can definitely tell a difference in this prepping my skin! I did receive this for free, but this hasn’t altered my review! This is so worth the price and I will be investing!

This lotion is amaaaazzinnnngg! It smells surprisingly good and it is not overpowering! Usually face lotions smell awful to me and it makes me self conscious but this one doesn’t! Decent primer. I’ll keep trying it for sure
I think this works very well. I enjoyed the experience of this mask. nice mild scent and left my skin feeling soft. I am not sure it did anything dramatic but I would recomend based on price point
Didn’t meet my needs, not moisturizing or nourishing at all.

one of the sales girls gave me a sample of this to use in flaky spots only and under my eyes at night. By far the best product ever. Do NOT put it on areas you break out, though. Just patches of dry skin.

Nice product to introduce retinol if you’re a beginner. A little amount of product is required so it will last quite a while. You can notice an effect fast if you use it correctly. Spf is a must so keep that in mind. Gifted by Farmacy.

Love the packaging and the color, but that’s all I love about it. Very sticky and not easy to apply even with that little stick. Fresh lipgloss melts.It breaks and falls on the floor.Lousy Lipgloss.

This product feels soothing and absorbs into skin very quickly. Doesn’t leave skin feeling sticky or oily. The smell is rather neutral but ultimately I didn’t see a huge difference in my skin and probably wouldn’t spend the money again.

My mom bought this product, and all I can say is WOW. My mom struggled with very dark area under her eyes. She have been using the product for about a month now. I can clearly see how much this product helped, she has a smoother, and very lighter area under her eyes. look no more ladies.

helps with texture and helps with the oil. I wear this under my foundation as a moisturizer and it’s so lightweight. I usually get oily after an hour and now I don’t have to touch up until a few hours and it’s not as much oil as before. before I would look like an oily mess and now I just look a bit shiny.
because of this, i never use other eye remover!!!! so perfect
I really wanted to love this but it’s just okay.  I thought I would get the moisturized feeling a lot longer. And my lips never felt any more soft that usual. Just a disappointment really.

I received this as trial for a fair review from influenster. I can’t say this serum really did much for me. I didn’t notice brighter looking skin, even skin tone or reduction in dark spots. I did however like that it wasn’t oily and there was a very potent sent. I would say it isn’t worth the money.

This is a great product. It’s texture is absolutely beautiful, lightweight and blends in gorgeously. Works well under makeup, and over cocktails of serums and moisturizers. This is an especially good product for darker skinned women.It’s effective, takes not too long to sink in, plays well with others, and I love that it’s a hundred percent mineral. It’s really hard to find a product this good in mineral sunscreens.I love it, still...I’m deducting two stars for its high cost and the small amount you get. A little does go a long way but liberal application is necessary with sunscreen and this tiny tube at a high price point is pretty ridiculous.I feel that making it so expensive is prohibitive, and those who buy this may be tempted to ration it and use less than they need, and that is a serious downside.

I am committed to natural skincare and have tried the diy route, lower cost options, and some higher cost options. I have oily, sensitive skin that I’ve discovered prefers facial oils over many other moisturizers. In the past I’ve tried vintner’s daughter and kypris 1000 roses, and I’ve found that Lapis rivals them both. My skin loves this oil, though I do use it only at night. I’ve noticed a more even tone and calmer skin since I’ve used it. This oil smells great (though quite herbal) and feels silly and luxurious when you apply.

I really wanted to try this product because I was tired of using cleansers that stripped my skin! I always thought that squeaky clean/tight feeling was a good thing with my other cleanser but then I learned that’s really bad for my normally oily skin. This is a game changer! it honestly feels so gentle and I will keep buying it!!! Skin doesn’t feel dry or tight and still feels clean.

Just because I got this for free for a test from Influenster, doesn’t mean I’m automatically in love with it. I had to wait for over a week so I can finally write up a review about this product. I do recommend to test it on your hand first to see if you have an allergic reaction because it does have some ingredients that would cause that

No streaks, natural looking color, easy to apply! It does not have a tanner smell when applying the product, however it does come through once it starts developing. I love the look of this fan though and will continue using it!

I buy this all the time because it is the only thing that truly protects my lips in the winter! The only thing I don’t like about it is that it’s so expensive... Definitely need to keep track of these to not lose them like most chapsticks
I hated this cleanser for my acne prone skin. It breaks me out every time I use it. It has a very creamy texture, which personally I hate, but is good for some I’m sure.

I’m a huge fan of the Ordinary products, however I think this one was my biggest disappointment. It’s my first time trying this type of product. I tried on a pimple that had already broken and on pimples that are still well under the skin. It sticks really well even if I wash my face. I wouldn’t go out with it thought lol it’s pretty obvious.For me, it’s a huge upgrade, because my skin would get super oily and then products would dry it so much that my skin would be bleeding and peeling off on specifc spots for months... So like... I’m really happy

I definitely couldn’t get 7 uses out of the sample. I think this cleanser was good. It wasn’t bad, but it didn’t wow me. I think the abrasion was mild, but my skin didn’t feel different after using it other than feeling a bit dry. I saw no difference in black heads or pore size, but I didn’t think I would since you can’t get rid of them. I did however experience a slight improvement of the texture of my skin after 2 days. I have milia like bumps and they were slightly diminished with the light exfoliation. I am debating on the full size since it did so make a difference in a couple of days. I do like Clinique as a brand and do like some of their other skin care products such as their gentle foaming cleanser. I received this product complimentary for review purposes, however, my opinions are my own and I will not lie or exaggerate because I received something. If you have similar skin issues as me and are wanting to try something new, give it a shot

The formula is ok. For a moisturizing cleanser, it lathers more than I expected it to. It also left my skin feeling tight and dry. I’m also quite disappointed in the packaging. One of the reasons why I stan Glow Recipe is due to the glass packaging. Not only is it more planet friendly, but their glass packaging is always so pretty. This one looks so cheap and like others have said, the slimy consistency spills out rapidly. I don’t know, overall this product feels rushed. I hope they don’t plan on releasing more products in plastic packaging because I’d honestly lose interest. I think this product has potential should they chose to reformulated it a bit and change its packaging.

Received this as a sample.  I was originally put off by the smell.  Thankfully it goes away after a bit.  Used it for 3 days in a row at bedtime.  Worked well around my nose and saw a visible difference in my pores.  However, the rest of my face was a different story.  I ended up with dry patches and small bumps around my chin and jaw line.  I will still use this on my nose but that is it.  Not sure if I will purchase when the sample is gone.
I got this as a free sample and it really never did anything for my combination skin.

I was gifted this product from OLEHENRIKSEN & Influenster in exchange for my honest review. The moisturizing aspect of this product is okay, but I failed to see a difference after using it consecutively. The scent is very mild which is nice.
It definitely does what it claims to do. The down side is that it feels sticky on my face.

I’ve been making my own toner at home for years because it’s cost effective, non-drying & the best toner I’ve used, and I’ve tried many. This rose toner plays on my all of my senses( sight, smell, and feel), however I’d say the price point isn’t worth it consistently. Not sure that I’ll purchase this at full price, but I definitely wouldn’t decline it if it was given to me as a gift!
I really like this because it feels like it actually does something. My skin did break out but because I was using all 3 products in this line, I can’t tell you if it was specifically this product.

I bought this product since I had a few deep breakouts that didn’t seem to want to go away. I wasn’t too confident since there was mixed reviews. I used these for a few nights and it sucks out all the crud in the zit! The dots were flat when I applied them and when I woke up they were puffed up and white. I literally saw one of them pull stuff from the zit when I peeled it off!! Best product to get rid of zits fast!!!

I was very excited to try this new Tatcha product. In typical Tatcha fashion, the packaging was on point. Absolute luxury from beginning to end. This cleanser has a very creamy and thick texture which surprised me. You can feel the tiniest grit in it. I was nervous because I have extremely dry and sensitive skin. I have used the same cleanser for years because I was nervous to try something new. However, this cleanser is PH balanced, so it didn’t strip my skin at all. I found the exfoliating element of it to be very gentle and beneficial. My skin feels so smooth! The only reason I am not giving this cleanser 5 stars is because of the smell. When I first smelled it, I thought it was very similar to my other Tatcha products. It has the typical luxury, spa facial type of smell. Wonderful. However, upon rubbing it in my hands and applying it to my face, there is almost a faint aftersmell of, dare I say....fish. It is extremely strange but also only lasts a second, so I can deal with it. I wonder if my bottle got too hot during shipping or something, because none of my other Tatcha products smell that way. If you can get past the smell, it is an amazing cleanser.

This product from Clinique IS fragrance-free (some are not - even though they advertise that everything is).It’s a good product, it is smoothing and keeps my skin moisturized. The only thing it doesn’t really do is change my skin for the better. I tend to prefer some higher quality brands that actually change my skin.

Although this product does smell really good, Ive been using it now for a couple months and I dont really see any signs of a tan on my face. it could be the other products i use interacting with it or something, but it does nothin essentially other than hydrating my skin. if it wasn’t $54 i wouldve just thrown it away, but im forcing myself to finish it now.

I was a little skeptical as I have tried some other celebrity skin care products and wasn’t super excited about those. However, this eye cream surpassed me. I love that it is moisturizing without being greasy. I can apply make up right after and don’t feel like the make up is sitting on my eyes. I also appreciate that it isn’t super scented not does it burn my eyes.  I did not notice a difference in fine lines, but I always think you need more time that just a month to really see a difference. All in all, I would totally recommend this.

When I saw this in the latest LUXE box I figured it was my opportunity to try it, to see what all the fuss is about.  While writing this review I’ve had it 9 days.    It is a very heavy cream and the directions advise not to rub in, but to pat and press into skin.  The special instructions did make using it feel “fancy” ( for lack of a better word).  I used it only at night but there is no way I could apply primer, sunscreen and makeup over this heavy cream.  ( believe me , I tried and it was a fail in 90° heat)   When I woke in the morning, my face was smooth and glowy  and baby soft.  I loved it as a nighttime cream and I believe it did it’s job as a moisturizer.  Here’s the thing.   It’s not  $300 good.  Ive used other $50 moisturizers that are HG’s  for me.   Don’t get me wrong, I’ll use the heck out of a free sample.  It just wasn’t impressive enough to get me on the LaMer bandwagon.

they work more quickly to help reduce pimples than other hydrocolloid patches and i’ve tried a bunch of different ones! (its the salicylic acid i guess?) only left off a star cause they are pricey for how many you get! but they work and they’re gentle and the acid didn’t dry my skin out leaving it over night !

I’m one of those people who’s had more breakouts as an adult than I ever did as a teenager. Nothing major, just a pimple every other month or so, but the ones I do get are massive and impossible to cover up.I use several skin care products from different lines, including Josie Maran Argan Oil at night. A few months ago, I made one change to my skin care routine, and that was adding this cleanser in the mornings. I have not had one breakout since then, and I couldn’t be happier. Yes, the application takes some getting used to, but it was well worth it for me. If your skin is prone to occasional breakouts, you should consider trying this cleanser.

So I was really skeptical buying this product although I had heard many good reviews but decided to give it a shot. I later realized after I continued to use it that it was creating a lot of texture and small bumps all over my face. The cream itself was very moisturizing although I just know it wasn’t suitable for my skin type at all. I have combination oily/dry skin and quite a bit of redness on my cheek areas with few breakouts occasionally. I believe (correct me if I’m wrong) but after doing some research and talking to my new skincare specialist that Salicylic acid and Hyaluronic acid aren’t normally treated for young and immature skin. At least not until about 22  because our skin cells turn over faster than that of matured skin. So if you are a younger adult like me looking for a good moisturizer; this is not the route to go.

I received a pack of GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel to try. There was a slight tingling when I applied to my face. The next morning my face felt very smooth to the touch. My face also felt tighter. I did not notice any difference in the appearance of my face. Although I did like how it made my face feel, I wouldn’t buy due to the price. I received this complimentary from goop.

This product really did fade my dark spots dramatically. However it also caused me to breakout tremendously. A bit counter-intuitive. My skin is pretty sensitive i’ve recently realized that i only get acne when I use acne removing/fading products. Now all i use is my makeup eraser cloth to remove my makeup which only needs to be wet with water alone! I love it. I use absoultely no products on my skin and now its clearer than EVER. Hope this helps for someone else out there:)

The balm itself it alright, its nothing special. I don’t see the hype around it. Sometimes when i put it on, it feels like an allergic reaction tingly type feeling, but other times it doesn’t happen. Its not just like a mint in the cold feeling either. Smells nice though. Wont repurchase.

Great color! No orange effect or streaks, it looks more as though you were laying out for a good few hours. Like any self tanner there is that distinct self tanner smell which I hate however I feel like with this product it’s really not as strong or noticeable as others so that was a plus! I didn’t use a mitt but I washed my hands immediately after applying and didn’t have any staining the next day. I would buy this again

I would not recommend using this to take eye makeup off, if it gets in your eyes it stings and after works my eyes feel like they’ve been dragged through mud and my skin feels raw. I received the 1 oz. bottle of Shani Darden retinol reform, and I think it works pretty good. The bottle itself is very heavy for there to be only 1 oz. of product. The retinol and lactic acid serum is yellow in color. It kind of has a funky smell, but nothing overpowering. It feels nice on my skin. I like it.

I wholeheartedly recommend this product and am so lucky to have found it! I’ve had these enlarged pores from more than a decade ago that has been bothering me for years. Got it in part from using traditional nose strips and trying to squeeze out remaining oils and blackheads. I wanted to try these Peace Out strips because you leave them overnight and they seem like they could cleanse much better. After using them for weeks, those enlarged pores are starting to fade and I’m thrilled!! Love this product!

I did not like this at all... it felt like washing my face with Vaseline. I’m only keeping it cause I’m too lazy to return and there’s a lockdown in Toronto still. It might be okay to use just as a make up remover and then cleanse again with a different cleanser.

Initially I tried a sample of this product and it was so good I had to purchase the full-size! Sephora can barely keep this in stock and it’s no surprise: the formula smells really good and is incredibly hydrating. This product is honestly so cheap for how well it works. I’ve tried products more than twice the price of this that did not work as well!

*I recieved this product complimentary for sampling purposes and all of these opinions are my own.* So because I received this for free and need to give an honest opinion, I didn’t want to review the product right away. I received and started using it around August 14th. I actually like it. I don’t use it for my full face because I actually thought it was an eye cream.. Which now I realize that it’s not. I have noticed my eyes look less tired and more moisturized. Whenever I’m at work, coworkers always ask if I am tired. I’m not it’s just allergies- helps with puffiness. The smell isn’t bad. To me, it did not have a strong scent. The texture is pretty thick so if you do have combination/oily skin I would just use it as an eye cream. If you have dry skin, go ahead and use it as a moisturizer. I also like how it feels when I put it on, it’s very creamy and smooth. It makes a great primer for concealer!! For those of you looking for the ingredients: BioNymph Peptide Complex, Hyaluronic Acid, and rosehip and camelia oils

The nose strip worked great, but the pore strips wreaked havoc on my skin- left bright red, dry/waxy areas where they were that was very difficult to cover up even with makeup and stayed visible for almost a week! Will definitely be using the nose strips again but probably will pass on the normal pore strips that are included. I left them on overnight.

Very hydrating product and didn’t leave my skin feeling sticky, but I feel like there are other serums out there that are just as good at a lower price point.I received this product complimentary to test and review

Though this product smells amazing, and does feel good on my skin, the application is confusing. It doesn’t soak into cotton because it’s thick, so I just rub it around like lotion. No noticeable improvement, but it isn’t bad. I received this for free from Influenster for testing purposes.

I got this for free from Influenster, but I don’t really like it. First off, it says you’ll see a noticable change in 4 weeks, but they only provided a week’s worth of product. I also do not like how it smells. It isn’t easy to apply because it just pours out instead of like a pump or dropper. I feel like for this price point, it should be better.

This product works well for its intended use but does not make any significant changes for the price tag. It promises a major change in as little as a week and while I did notice my skin was glowy, nothing too crazy.

This was lightweight and absorbed quickly. It didn’t make my face feel greasy. I liked the scent which was very lemony. The scent was initially strong when applying the cream but faded quickly into a nice hint of lemon.
The smell is absolutely heavenly! Just like smelling freshly peeled oranges but better!! Perfect for people with oily skin!!

I received this to try out from Influenster. I wasn’t extremely impressed as it seemed just like Vaseline to me, however it did still work and moisturized my lips overnight. My lips get insanely dry and cracked, especially in the winter so I’ll continue to use this until it’s gone!

I received this product as a free sample from Influenster. I do like this product, the formula is light and does not feel suffocating to the skin. However, the scent is a little off-putting if you don’t like the smell of yogurt and takes quite a while to fade. The texture also is a bit sticky on the skin.

I received a sample for free for my review. I was in the middle of moving so I didn’t get to use it for a very long time. But the time I was able to, I really enjoyed it. The cream was thick like spun honey, but glided onto my skin very nicely and my under eyes were feeling good! It’s very moisturizing! It does have a faint scent to it, but not overpowering or annoying. I can’t wait to use it some more!

I received this from Influenster and after trying it for a few weeks I was not truly impressed. It wasn’t oily but did take a while to dry down. It left my skin much lighter and you could tell I’d put something on so I wouldn’t wear this alone. I wore it under makeup and by end of day my chin was dry and breaking apart when that doesn’t happen with any other product of used. I have dry skin so maybe the matte formula didn’t agree with me skin. It didn’t break me out but it’s just not going to a go to for me.
Clogged my pores causing me to breakout. Would not recommend for someone with acne.

I received  the Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Ultra Dark Spot Correcting Cream SPF 30 free to review, and would buy this 10 times over. First let me start by saying i am 44 with dry skin, reddy cheeks, some dark spots near my hair line, and of course the lovely wrinkles and fine lines we all get with age. i use higher end face creams, so i was excited to see how Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Ultra Dark Spot Correcting Cream SPF 30 would stack up. i was not disappointed.i used the cream for a good month before filling out this review and in this time span i found that my skin is softer, tighter, less red, the dark spots have faded and my lines and wrinkles have softened. the cream is so emolument,it takes only a dab, and has a wonderful fragrance that is trademark of Lancome.it does fade though, so if you are sensitive to smells don’t worry. i was able to wear Make up over Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Ultra Dark Spot Correcting Cream SPF 30 without any problems. It is not a greasy feeling cream nor does it make you feel overly weighed down. i do feel like my skin feels tighter and springs back easier. Overall i would say this cream does everything it claims. plus i love having a built in sunscreen! this is now my go to face cream

The term “gel” is wrong. When I hear gel, I think light and cooling. This is like slathering glue on your face. The smell is also horrible.  I never notice the bad smell that people talk about in reviews but this one is baddddd. I’m still using it because it cleanses just fine but I cant wait for it to be done.

I have been using this stuff every night for 2 weeks and I honestly didn’t expect too notice such a difference so quickly. My skin was looking so dull and uneven this winter and this product has done exactly what I wanted it to! The price is just spot on and I look forward too trying out more from The Ordinary in the future!

This product feels really nice when I apply it, but there is no discernible difference in my undereye puffiness after using it. I will continue to use what I have on mornings when I feel extra tired, or after crying, just because it feels good and cooling. But I would not purchase again.

I wanted to like this spf since I love the brand. But the thick formula just isn’t for me. This left me with a white cast that was impossible to blend in. It didn’t make me breakout or anything even though I have sensitive skin so that’s good. I also like that the sunscreen is ocean-friendly which is very thoughtful of the brand.
Feels like a spa on the face. It’s cooling in this hot weather and it’s works so well.
So far I like it, as it does cover redness (and I have a lot of redness) but it has a strong scent. I tend to like unscented or lighter scented products.
Cleanse gently and very good. I don’t like the bottle. It’s not comfortable to use
This mask stings when you put it on! My skin looked bright and glowy afterwards. I don’t think it results are worth the price.

I knew this face wash would be drying but I didn’t mind because I used to use proactiv which dries your skin out also. However, because this was drying it made my skin even oilier! I have normal-oily skin and this just made me crazy oily. I’ve never had this problem with other skin drying products. It does deep clean your skin and exfoliate it because of the acids in it, but if you stop using it your skin will break out like crazy. I hope they reformulate this because I really wanted to like it :/

I’m using this cream for about 10 days, first days my skin became red and a bit sensitive after several times of use now it’s better just so shiny don’t forget to take a very small amount. my skin type is combination.

I have very very sensitive skin and this cleansed it without any additional irritation, so I liked it quite well. I’m not sure how much it did for my acne because I was using it with the other two products in this line, but it didn’t dry me out significantly.

I like this mask as a makeup prep step, doesn’t tingle like the grapefruit sheet mask which I enjoy so, I question the vitamin c concentrations in comparison but, otherwise a luxurious whipped texture and pleasant mask experience. Leaves skin soft and hydrated.
I prefer mud masks. They really suck out all the dirt from your pores. The inkey list one is too gentle and I don’t really see the difference before and after

I received this product as a sample. I regularly use the microfoliant(which I love). I was put off by the colour ,the smell and the feel of the powder once I had mixed it with water. After I had rinsed my face, I noticed that I had actually had a reaction to this product and that the skin on my face felt extremely tight. I have reactive skin and it is difficult to try new products.  So with that in mind I am giving it 1 star. It may be great for others, but for me it was a fail. I will be going back to my tried, tested and true Daily Microfoliant.

Four stars for overall awesomeness and minus one for the sulfur smell. My oily (combo) skin feels much better. If you can get past the smell, it’s totally worth it. I’ve sucked it up because it is totally worth it.

Although this product makes a lot of claims and is heavily promoted by Sephora videos, I did not find any significant decrease in under eye puffiness, smoothing of lines. It is probably effective for those who do not have any puffiness or lines.
Personally, after using for months- I maybe saw the slightest difference. But honestly, not that good. There’s so much better out there.

I am pleasantly surprised by this moisturizer! As opposed to those water/gel like consistencies, the texture of this product is pretty thick, creamy, and rich. It def packs a load of hydration into my skin and I find myself reaching for it every time before I do makeup. I have combo skin and it works fine.
This stuff really does truly work; I will always repurchase. But it smells so bad. To me it smells like nair/veet. It’s worth it, but hopefully they will tweak the scent in the future

This eye cream did not disappoint! I loved the formula and texture of it! I have very sensitive skin under my eyes and a lot of eye creams and moisturizers can sometimes burn me, I didn’t have that sensation at all with this one. I have do have hereditary under eye bags but the darkness is something I like to treat so they’re not as noticeable. I did notice some brightening effect, mostly bc I felt like I needed less concealer for my under eyes!
Cleansing powder is a very novel way to wash your face.  A big bottle.  Can be used for a long time.  It doesn’t feel very dry after washing, it’s okay.  Recommend everyone to use this.

Although this doesn’t smell typically like caramel, it’s a sweet but somewhat artificial fragrance with a detectable citrus note in it. The balm itself has quite a thick texture and is quite rich. It leaves a nice sheen on my lips which keeps them plumped and looking good whilst the balm is on, however I don’t feel it provides any long-term hydration or conditioning and my lips feel pretty much as they did before, once I’ve washed this off. The balm itself also doesn’t last very long. I started with the Coconut version which I found much more true to how it should smell, although neither that pot, nor the Caramel one have lasted me for longer than 3 weeks each. Pleasantly surprised by this product! A small amount goes a long way, and the consistency is smooth and easily absorbed. I didn’t find that it lasted quite as long as my regular moisturizer, but it did have immediate and noticeable positive effect on my skin. The smell was a little strong but not unpleasant.

This is one of my least favorite sunscreens. It feels and looks greasy on my skin. It makes my face look shiny and oil-y and just feels.... gross on my skin.  It also leaves little white pills no matter how hard I try and rub it in (and if I get any in my eyebrows, it looks like eyebrow dandruff)  I’ve been experimenting with different sunscreens and this has been my least favorite so far! I expected so much more from Drunk Elephant.

I use the Origins Out of Trouble mask for years and loved it. This one is way more drying without delivering better results. My skin tightens to a point that’s physically uncomfortable and actually wrinkles beneath the mask. But the results (in terms of clearing pores) are less noticeable than with the Out of Trouble. This may be good for very oily skin, but I won’t be finishing my tube.
If the price point for this product wasn’t so high I would give it 5 stars. I definitely have noticed a difference in my skin since using this. Moisturized, smooth and a much more even skin tone!

This product is light,  scent less,  and the packaging is shiny pretty packaging.  This eye cream is moisturizing. I’ve been trying the fresh take eye cream and I can’t say that I’ve seen a difference in the dark circles around my eye.

Love the product and the way it applies, the color always looks good and is buildable. Star off because I’ve purchased twice and both times the pump has broken when I’m hardly even halfway through the bottle. Super disappointing, am considering a different formula from Isle of Paradise..

I received a mini version of this moisturizer for free after making a purchase off the Tatcha website. However, if you purchase the mini version yourself, the retail value is $20. This seems a bit expensive for such a small amount of the moisturizer. This face cream absorbs into the skin well, and there isn’t necessarily anything “bad” about it. However, I much prefer The Silk Cream because it absorbs into the skin better and is slightly lighter. The Dewy Cream leaves your skin a little shiny/glowy, so this may be a good face cream for those searching for a winter moisturizer or those with dry skin.

I really wanted to like this product because I appreciate The Ordinary’s mission of quality products at a decent price, but this was not for my oily skin. It did help blur my acne scars a tad, but I would get so oily after using this product, which outweighed the blurring effect. For the price though, it wasn’t really any skin off my back.

I wanted to love this product, but unfortunately it caused me to break out so badly. I’m giving it a 3 though because it made my skin feel so hydrated and soft, unfortunately I wouldn’t recommend it if you have acne-prone skin

Moisturing but not oily. Not drying after. Very nice smell. Skin is soft after. The next morning I saw subtle brightness and glow.Keep it for 20 minutes instead of the 10 mins in the instructions for better results.
This’s was so good for my dry skin!!!!! My skin just drank it up and it smells so good!
This is such a nice product! It smells amazing and i really felt a difference in my skin. I could see a slight difference in my pores and felt really refreshed.
Worth it! I have bought at least 4 of these and i cant get enough! I cant find anything like it! It leaves my dry skin looking luminous all day!
Good eye moisturizer for the price but I haven’t noticed any change in the appearance of my dark circles. I have been using this product for 3 months now.
I was given this product to test and I’m so thankful I did. My skin feels tighter and more lively. I would hope everyone would see such a difference in their skin after using.
This is not doing anything for my dark circles! Sigh.

This cleanser works well, took off makeup and cleaned with out drying.  I gave 4 stars because of the smell. I never understood reviews when people said they couldn’t stand the smell about certain products - now I know what they are talking about.  This smells awful.  When this runs out I will go back to Kiehls Ultra Facial Cleanser

I really enjoy this as a gentle, first-step cleanse. I will often wash my face with just this in the morning, and in the evening I will use this then the Youth to the People Kale Cleanser. It removes my sunscreen and eye makeup with no issue. It has a pleasant, natural smell that I enjoy. My only complaint about this product is that mine looks nothing like the photos or even other reviewer’s photos. Mine has a clear, jelly consistency but I have basically no pink in mine. I figure this is probably just a different batch and it hasn’t affected my experience negatively, but I don’t like the inconsistency. Overall great cleanser and comparable to the Inkey List Oat Cleanser (the Biossance one is less greasy feeling)

The packaging is beautiful and luxe and reminds me of the St Germaine liquor bottle. the texture is a little strange at first, but you just have to pat it in and give some time I cannot slap my spf on right after Its very thin and clear and can run so a little at a time is needed. I’m not super young but since I take care of my skin I’m not seeing the results someone more dehydrated and drier (less oil production) would see. radiance comes with hydration and this is described as a triple threat 3 in 1. as far as claims for plumping, I’m not sure I have enough lines to tell. I don’t think i would repurchase. it will take me a long time to use up. the dropper dosent always grab the beads because the products settle. the smell is more prominent than some might like but not unpleasant. its a gourmand sweet smell, almost like a sweet perfume. it does linger on the skin. I love the honey bee on the bottle thats also from recycled glass, I will probable repurpose when its empty. but I still feel really lucky to have been gifted such a gorgeous product to review.

In my opinion this is one of the best lip balms out there and I am somewhat of a lip balm snob. It has a thin consistency that genuinely moisturizes your lips so that you don’t have to reapply all day. It even works well to break down hard to take off liquid lipsticks. Just one swipe over the liquid lip and it easily comes off with a tissue.Real talk though, I’ve been buying this product religiously for the last two years but have decided to stop buying this product until Fresh fixes the packaging. Once you get down to the bottom there is a TON of product left in the bottom plastic part. You are forced to either waste it or scoop it out with a qtip or cosmetic spatula. For the price and with so many other excellent lip balms on the market it is no longer worth it to me.Also if you do buy this, be careful about keeping it in your car on a hot day. It melts very easily!

I take this w Moon Juice Hair and Nail vitamins, and have seen a nice difference in my skin. I’m 51 and am in the sun a lot, and I feel that this has made my skin look moist / not as dry, and has lessened the wrinkles and fine lines. Now I only see wrinkles when I smile, where I was seeing them even when my face was relaxed. Some reviewers thought they were big / awkward to take, but I have had bigger pills, and have no problems swallowing these as well as 4 Hair and Nails pills - just drink lots of water!

I have dry/sensitive/acne prone skin, This drys me out every time I use it. It also is not gentle , I feel a tingling sensation after messaging it into my skin. it stings my skin a little. Does not remove makeup completely. I’m starting to get mini bumps on my forehead, this cleanser still leaves makeup on my skin so that is why I get bumps on my forehead. My skin does NOT feel soften or soothe or hydrating false claims this products makes. Not suitable for all skin types. I give it 3 stars because I sure it works great for other people but my skin type it does not work.
In my opinion do not use if u are acne prone!! It clogged my pores and left little whiteheads and blackheads on my cheeks.also it’s not very hydrating it left my skin the same,dry.
Super high shine and not very moisturizing. Bought two thinking it was on par with the lip mask and gave the other away to a friend to try.

This new formula is not as good as the old RNA cream. It is heavily scented and I do not feel that it is as long lasting on my skin. It’s a sufficient moisturizer but now not worth the money in my opinion. Please bring back the old formula.
The scent is very lovely, not too strong or artificial. This isn’t something I reach for when my lips are very dry. The packaging is so cute and very high quality, quite small though.
This is a prefect example of a product that is visually appealing but does nothing.
It turns your skin a little yellow but the worst part is the smell. It smells so strongly of fish oil. Maybe they used that as a carrier? I don’t know. I just know I have to return it.

I got this bc it basically has every anti-melasma ingredient in there. I have been using this for 3 months on my stubborn hyperpigmentation I have on my nose from wearing hot sunglasses over time (PSA, don’t wear hot sunglasses in your car on your face, especially if you’re a woman of color. Heat = hyperpigmentation). Anyways, I’ve successfully lightened my hyperpigmented areas with 2-3% OTC hydroquinone in the past, but I think using that has made my melasma more stubborn to fading long-term. Also, you’re supposed to take breaks from hydroquinone, which is annoying.Sadly, for me Faded is sadly not as effective as hydroquinone despite me using it twice a day for 3 months. Since I’m a fan of the ingredients & don’t plan on going back to hydroquinone, I will keep using Faded until I’m done with tube & update. It may just be that my stubborn dark marks need more time with this product.

i had never tried anything from Tula before but was sent this toner from influenster. i’m a huge fan of the glycolic acid from The Ordinary and used this in direct comparison. all in all, i like it! it seems to work just as effectively as the toner i currently use. i did remove a star because the only way i’m able to use the pump is by turning this upside down ? i think maybe my pump was defective but considering the price difference between this Tula product vs The Ordinary toner, that’s pretty annoying. all in all i liked it and i felt it was effective with reducing the size of blemishes as well as reduce texture. if you love Tula and need a toner then i’d say it’s a great option! if you already have a glycolic acid that works for you though, i don’t think this is worth replacing.
I’ve used this product for months. Did not really make a difference to to my face. Did not help with redness nor acne

I’m very particular about my skin products being feee of certain harsh chemicals, yet still affective. I truly didn’t think I would like this as much as I did. It’s literally like silk in a bottle. It glides on your face so smooth. It doesn’t create suds but it makes your face feel clean but moisturized. This is great to use after a purifying mask like charcoal. I received this product complimentary for eating purposes but I I’ll be purchasing once it’s finished!
So far not good. I have been using this daily for three weeks and have not seen any change with my dark spots. I will continue to use and if it starts to work, I will revisit this revue.
Pretty decent product, a little high on the price point. The results were good, I did notice reduced puffiness with continued use and my skin feels soft and supple.
Pretty good product. It’s not sticky and spreads smoothly.
I like this product it was pretty good. I used on my nose area and my skin is really dry in that area and peeling.

First off, Clinique is meant for folks with sensitive skin, folks who break out easily, and what not. Some of these other reviews saying “there’s nothing special about this product “ is completely false! Sure there’s lots of products at Sephora with all kinds of fancy anti aging ingredients BUT Clinique is meant to be simple people!

I sought out a forum to give my opinion about this product....I am THAT impressed. (Exfoliate Paula’s Choice). I eat organic, healthy, no fragrances....but for some reason in the past few years, I have been breaking out daily with little pimples. I went through menopause 10 years ago, was wondering if it was chlorine in the water - it was driving me crazy. So I caught a youtube video with a girl talking about different facial bacteria/yeast/breakouts etc., and this was one of the products she recommended. I use it after bathing, and NO more breakouts! Happyhappyhappy....I am SO relieved to have clear skin again.I am a well-preserved 61, btw, and didn’t get anything for this review.
My favorite night time moisturizer. The formula feels so nice and luxurious. I have not noticed any changes in my skin just feels good. (I also do not currently have any skin issues)
Fave fave oil. Doesn’t break me out or cause redness. Maybe it’s the cbd?

I really wanted to love this product, but I just don’t think it was right for my skin type. The product is geared for those with dry skin and I’m more on the side of combo/normal. But I got a sample and needed to give it a try!The product itself smells strong, though pretty yummy. It blended on like a dream and didn’t transfer onto my pillowcase or anything overnight. I got comments from others that my skin looked brighter after use, which is awesome. However, I did find that I was starting to breakout after my second and third trials.A wonderful product, but maybe just not for me!

I wanted to give this  product a fair shot so I waited about 30 days to write my review. I received it through the influenster program. It is a very nice toner, you can feel it working. Your face is definitely a little sensitive after use because of the AHA (alpha hydroxy acid) which is a chemical exfoliant.  It was a great toner, but I moisturized about 5 minutes after putting it on. I’m not sure i’d go for it if I saw it in store; I’d rather do the BBL (broad band light) therapy and KNOW that my skin damage is going away.
